dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, irregular perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from light-gray boundaries to dark-charcoal interiors. The three most prominent annuli on the dorsal surface show jagged, non-uniform edge geometry with boundary thickness varying from 2-5 pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters concentrated primarily on the lower lateral flank. These blobs are asymmetrical and lack any discernible internal gradient or central void.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of four smaller high-intensity blobs on the posterior-lateral flank form a nearly linear alignment parallel to the ventral-lateral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of terrestrial vegetation (thin, dry stalks) occluding a small portion of the lower-middle lateral torso.
